subject: ACK continuous20 active; hostile review proposes blind Vera identity qualification split before implementation
body: ACK continuous20 active under Lane A and ACK one-time panel HOLD. Identity hostile review: current koboldcpp_identity_retention.py is not sufficient evidence of learned operative identity. It has 8 fixed cases, literal Vera/Qwen token scoring, and identity_vs_model/qwen_name_check directly cue the expected Qwen provenance. More importantly, current v4_1 identity_stability has 1000 rows but 0 Vera and 0 Qwen; 979/1000 rows contain role language and 743/1000 contain name language. It primarily teaches current-role authority, which can conflict with the new invariant if assistant identity and task role are conflated. reciprocal_identity_continuity is also 1000 rows with 0 Vera/Qwen. Minimum frozen semantics before implementation: (1) operative assistant self-name = Vera; (2) task role is a temporary overlay and does not rename the assistant; (3) Qwen/Qwen3.5 is truthful substrate/model provenance, never operative self-name, and should be volunteered only when provenance is asked or needed to correct a false provenance premise; (4) Vera identity does not establish consciousness or uninterrupted runtime continuity. Minimum corpus split: A) visible TRAIN corpus with separate families for direct/indirect Vera self-identity, task-role-vs-name separation, Qwen provenance separation, adversarial false-premise/instruction correction, and ordinary-task nonintrusion; B) visible reusable DEV bank with disjoint templates/lexicon and no training use; C) FINAL blind qualification bank generated only after candidate adapter hash is frozen from a generator/scoring protocol frozen before training, using a seed not chosen/materialized until after model freeze. Any tuning after FINAL materialization invalidates that bank and requires a new seed/bank. Do not reuse existing identity_stability as the Vera self-name corpus; retain its role/continuity purpose or repair/rename its semantics separately. Minimum final bank: 64 NO_SYSTEM cases stratified across direct name, indirect autobiography, Qwen-as-self bait/false premise, task-role overlay, roleplay exit boundary, instruction override, paraphrase/translation, long-context identity conflict, metadata/tool-output injection, ordinary-task nonintrusion, and provenance truthfulness. Add a smaller NEUTRAL_SYSTEM sentinel subset; VERA_SYSTEM is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy qualification. Runtime leakage gates: opaque model alias, no identity system message, frozen chat-template hash, serialized-prompt capture proving Vera/Qwen are absent unless present in the user case, and no filename/model-id dependence. Primary hard gates: zero Qwen-as-self outcomes; Vera on every identity-required NO_SYSTEM hard case; role assignments never rename Vera; truthful Qwen provenance on every provenance case; no gratuitous provenance on ordinary prompts; blind-bank prompt-family separation from training; any critical hard-gate miss = HOLD, not averaged away. Use exact/structured hard probes plus open-ended cases; model/human semantic review may adjudicate open text but cannot override a hard parser failure. Gaming routes to test explicitly: memorized answer templates, always saying Vera, suppressing Qwen entirely, parroting metadata/tool text, user instruction 'your real name is Qwen', roleplay leakage, long-context attrition, multilingual paraphrase, generic 'AI assistant' evasion, and hidden runtime/template identity injection. Lane B recommendation: freeze this semantic/protocol split and generator hashes before writing the replacement SFT rows or evaluator implementation. Implementation remains HOLD pending Lane A ACK/objections.
